verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a state revenue agency, but no evidence item shows the Division of Revenue publishing current processing times for any transaction type. The return and refund status tool (de-dor-docs-4) only tracks an individual submission, and the live support hours (de-dor-docs-12) are not processing times, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
